title: Phantom Battery Drain While Parked
dataSources: Tesla vehicle/charge state (`tesla:vehicle`, `tesla:charge`), TeslaMate MQTT, OBD-II PIDs (`obd:pid`), Smartcar API (`smartcar:vehicle`), charger sessions (`evcharger:session`).
app: Tesla Fleet API / TeslaMate, Teslafi, and generic OBD-II / Smartcar / manufacturer APIs via HEC scripted inputs and MQTT bridges.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=tesla:vehicle shift_state="P"
| sort 0 _time
| delta battery_pct as drop p=1
| eval drain=abs(drop)
| bin _time span=1d
| stats sum(drain) as pct_lost_parked by _time
| where pct_lost_parked>3
description: Measures how much charge your car loses overnight while parked and flags days with unusually high standby drain.
value: Excessive phantom drain points at settings like sentry mode or cabin overheat protection quietly eating your range and money.
implementation: Ingest parked vehicle state; schedule daily and investigate settings when overnight drain exceeds your tolerance.
visualization: Column chart of daily charge lost while parked.
grandmaExplanation: It shows how much battery your car quietly loses while parked, so you can turn off settings that waste it.
